question: Identify the synonym of 'Recalcitrant':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Rebellious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Recalcitrant"** refers to someone or something that is obstinately uncooperative, especially toward authority or discipline. (अवज्ञाकारी)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The recalcitrant student refused to follow the teacher’s instructions.
 
 
 
• **"Rebellious"**, the correct synonym, means resisting control or authority; showing a desire to rebel. (विद्रोही)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The rebellious teenager often argued with her parents about their rules.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **"Recalcitrant"** is **"Rebellious"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Rebellious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Compliant** (अनुपालन करने वाला): Willing to agree or obey rules or standards.
 
 
• **Example:** The compliant employee followed all the company policies without question.
 
 
 
 
• **Submissive** (आज्ञाकारी): Ready to conform to the authority or will of others; meekly obedient.
 
 
• **Example:** She had a submissive nature and rarely voiced her own opinions.
 
 
 
 
• **Docile** (शांतिपूर्ण): Easily managed or handled; gentle and willing to be taught.
 
 
• **Example:** The docile puppy quickly learned to obey commands.
 
 

**Question:** Identify the synonym of 'Recalcitrant':

 
• 1) Compliant
 
• 2) Rebellious
 
• 3) Submissive
 
• 4) Docile
